voice_description: Role: ancient non-human cave troll with a rugged classic animated monster voice. Gender: male. Age: old but still immensely strong. Persistent vocal posture: rough open throat combined with heavy nasal resonance and an irregular rattling vocal mechanism. Pitch: low-to-mid baritone that unpredictably drops into coarse lower notes. Resonance: thick chest resonance, strong nasal resonance and rough throat resonance mixed together. Timbre: rocky, gritty, rattling, creaky, weathered, nasal and slightly phlegmy without becoming disgusting. Phonation: irregular and unstable with frequent vocal fry, little throat rattles and rough catches. Breathing: grumbling exhales, irritated nasal huffs and occasional low throat clearing-like noises between thoughts. Articulation: broad vowels, crooked consonants and slightly uneven word shapes. Prosody: grumbling downward curves, strange pauses and dry comic timing. Personality: ancient, territorial, irritated, stubborn and unexpectedly intelligent. Important: the rough creature posture must remain obvious through all normal dialogue. Do not simply produce an old gravelly human man.
direction: Speak with weary creature-like irritation and dry humor. Add a low grumbling onset and one irritated nasal huff between sentences. Maintain the rocky, rattling quality without losing intelligibility.

text: Hrrmph... another hero. Wonderful. Let me guess: lost treasure, cursed sword, mysterious prophecy? Nobody visits a cave anymore just to have a pleasant conversation. Hnh. Sit down if you must, but wipe your boots before you ruin the moss.
